+  # The legacy services only shrink. A pull request is the only place a name can
+  # be added, so this compares the branch with the commit it forked from.
+  job_legacy_services:
+    name: Check legacy services
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    needs: [job_setup]
+    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.job_setup.outputs.changed_service_inventory == 'true'
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout PR head commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - name: Fetch PR base branch
+        # Through env, never interpolated into the script: a branch name can
+        # carry shell metacharacters, and template expansion happens before the
+        # shell parses the command.
+        env:
+          PR_BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
+        run: git fetch --no-tags origin "+refs/heads/${PR_BASE_REF}:refs/remotes/origin/${PR_BASE_REF}"
+      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
+        with:
+          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
+          trust-lockfile: 'true'
+          # The check and the inventory reader each read YAML with their own
+          # workspace's parser.
+          install-args: --filter @internal/scripts --filter @internal/cfg-oxlint --ignore-scripts
+          store-cache: 'false'
+      - name: Check legacy services only shrink
+        env:
+          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          PR_BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
+        run: node tools/scripts/ci/check-legacy-services.ts
